title: Department Of Science Technology
definition: The Department of Science and Technology (DST), operating under the Ministry of Science and Technology, Government of India, is the nodal agency for formulating policies, promoting, funding, and coordinating frontier research, science popularization, and technology development in the country.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for UPSC CSE Prelims (factual questions on autonomous bodies, autonomous research institutes, national portals, and flagship schemes) and Mains GS Paper III (Science & Technology - indigenization of technology, capacity building, R&D funding, policy frameworks, and applications of S&T for national development).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Department Of Science Technology.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Basic understanding of India's institutional architecture for scientific research
Overview of Ministry of Science and Technology components
